systems.owner: ministère de l'Intérieur et de la Décentralisation, with the PRODIGY project
systems.tiers: launch on 27 January 2026 starting in the district of Atsimondrano; national deployment April to June 2026 with 2,500 biometric kits in 1,729 enrolment centres, six days a week, to attribute a Numéro d'Identification Unique (NUI)

note: Identity enrolment only; no civil registration system is described.
